# https://vntu-agency.pages.dev

> VNTU Agency is a London-based, specialist event production team led by Rebekah Dennis. We deliver B2B conferences, brand activations, networking dinners, pop-up events, webinars, workshops and venue monetisation programmes for SMEs and enterprise organisations across the UK. 9+ years experience. Human-first, AI-assisted production process.
